variants.name: 드라큘라
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one square 1024x1024 Halloween launcher app icon concept for Sobrita, a friendly personal budgeting app.
Primary request: create a seasonal Dracula treatment of the CURRENT APP ICON in reference image 1. This is concept 1 of 3, but output ONLY ONE standalone icon. Do not output a comparison sheet.
Reference image 1 is the identity and composition reference: preserve its recognizable large cream CALICO CAT FACE with an orange patch over the viewer-left eye/ear, brown patch at viewer-right, coral cheeks, two large green eyes, cream budget ledger held in exactly TWO small cream paws, colored budget cells, and round gold dollar coin in the lower-right of the ledger. Preserve the broad silhouette and approximate face-to-ledger proportions. Reference image 2 is ONLY a costume reference for a red-and-black vampire cape/collar and cheerful small fangs; do NOT borrow its blue fur or amber eyes.
Design: give the calico cat a simple red-lined black Dracula collar behind its cheeks, two very tiny cute fangs, and a red bow at the neck partly hidden behind the ledger. Dark navy square background with very subtle pixel grid, one small golden crescent in an upper corner. Keep ledger and coin very legible. Friendly and festive, not frightening.
Style: polished chunky pixel art matching reference 1, visible square pixels, restrained stepped shading, strong near-black pixel outline; no smooth vector outlines, no painterly furry detail.
Composition: centered face and ledger fill roughly central 76% of canvas, important details within central 70% for circle/squircle icon masks. Background extends edge to edge, no pre-rounded corners, no outer frame, no transparent corners, no external shadow or phone mockup. Strong contrast at 48px.
Constraints: exactly two ears, two eyes, exactly two visible paws holding ledger, no extra limbs. No full body. No text other than the original dollar sign on the gold coin. No labels, numbers, banners, watermark, pumpkins competing with the focal face.
